t: Happy to help you increase your reputation.

Participate in skirmishes in Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Old Fortress, and Battle for Cargallas. For participation, victories, and first three positions in the healing and damage rankings, you will receive Collector's Coins which you can transfer to your account. You can also spend them on the goods I'm selling. We also have a special agreement with the Boutique. They sell certificates that will temporarily increase the number of Collector's Coins you earn. What else would you like to know?

My employers are planning to invest in this new booming entertainment. You surely attracted attention! The Tycoon Club believes in your potential, and therefore, they're going to help you. To help you shine, we are ready to give you access to our especially rare goods, which you can't find in a regular Boutique.

The Tycoon Club is pleased with the way things are going. The Gladiator skirmishes are gaining popularity. People are craving new bloodier shows. My employer might consider raising funds. You are getting more and more famous, and the public wants to see you. You just can't stop now! Go on, prove yourself! We are going to support you. Enjoy access to the special goods that will help you in battle.

Rumor has it, the Tycoons are mobbed up... well, that's true. Alas, it's the astral pirates are the only way to get the rarest goods. We're offering them to you as a gesture of good faith. Admittedly, we were right to place our bets on you! You proved to be a truly great and mighty warrior, deserving the eternal glory on the battlefield. Of course, you've got both friends and foes, but they all admit that you're the best in battle. They'll be happy to witness your skill in the coming battles!

I'm sure you've heard of it. The Tycoon Club consists of seven richest merchants. In these challenging times my employers are looking for ways to divert people's attention from the main trouble and get some profit. I see nothing wrong here! What can be more profitable than heavy betting on bloody skirmishes? I was tasked with finding brave and bold people to participate in the skirmishes. Your input will be very much appreciated! Who knows, you might succeed! Are you willing to take a chance?
I'll be happy if you decide to join us. You will receive payment in Tycoon Collector's Coins, which you can spend on rare items or donate to our special fund to increase your reputation. We will monitor your progress. Fight! It is up to you whether you make it a success or a failure.
Greetings! Do you want to be a hero and become famous?
I'm buying and selling, that's all you need to know.

Participate in skirmishes in Training Camp and earn Training Camp Explorer tokens. Your gain will be bigger for a victory, and you will receive a bonus if you rank one of the first three positions in healing and damage ratings. You can credit them to your account or spend them on the goods I'm selling. What else would you like to know?

The Zem had very tricky machinery. Very hard to handle. But don't worry, our researchers have discovered a thing or two. They're dismantling the gears and hinges. I can sell you the things they're done studying.

Thank you for your help, friend! The more we study the complex devices, the more scary they get. The Zem did awful things. All their machinery was meant to pull the life force from the living beings. Ugh, what a dirty trick! The Training Camp was the facility where they studied feeding the life energy to the dead things. There's nothing left to do but keep up the research. As for you, you have our gratitude and a couple of curious things.

What can I say? We worked out everything. Although I don't think it's for the best. You're one of us now, so you should be prepared for the truth! Here we go. The Training Camp was a facility where they studied leeching life from the living things and redirecting it to the dead. All golems and other clockwork monsters were inactive for many years - until people came and started killing one another. The blood was spilled. It gave new energy to the golems. You know what, I think you should keep it secret. People are uncomfortable enough already. I'll describe it as it is for Catherina, though. Perhaps, she'll find a way to fix things. As for you, I expect your silence in exchange to access to all our findings.

Have you ever heard about the Training Camp? You know, the green spot full of golems. You should know it. It's a mysterious place. The Zem heritage. You see, they lost most of their secrets after death, and they're trying to recover them. They're ahead of us, and it makes me sad. But I'm sure it won't be long now! By the order of Queen Catherina we recruited the wisest and most educated men to dismantle the Zem wonders piece by piece and figure out how they work. If the Empire can do it, so can we! But we need help. Your help. We won't leave your favor unpaid! We'll share all our findings. So, what do you say?

Are you willing to help? You will receive payment in Training Camp Explorer tokens, which you can spend on different things we find there or donate to increase your reputation. Don't abandon us! The League, our Motherland, needs your help!

The Zem had very tricky machinery. Very hard to handle. But don't worry, the research is well under way. The researchers are dismantling the gears and hinges. I can sell you the things they're done studying.

The results are rather curious, comrade! The more we study the complex devices, the more interesting they get. The Zem did amazing things. All their machinery was meant to pull the life force from the living beings. The Training Camp was the facility where they studied feeding the life energy to the dead things. They animated them without any other power sources! We're so excited to continue the research. As for you, you have our gratitude and a couple of curious things.

What can I say? It's a real scientific breakthrough. I can't believe we failed to figure it out earlier. You're one of us now, so you should be prepared for the truth! Here we go. The Training Camp was a facility where they studied leeching life from the living things and redirecting it to the dead. All golems and other clockwork monsters were inactive for many years - until people came and started killing one another. The blood was spilled. It gave new energy to the golems. You know what, I think you should keep it secret. We don't want anyone to interfere with our research by claiming it "unethical". As for you, I expect your silence in exchange to access to all our findings. Enjoy!

What do you know about the Training Camp? Nothing? I thought so. Don't get upset, none of us knows enough. That's the problem, the Zem heritage is huge, and it has a lot of mysteries, hunted for by the League. We shouldn't let them lay their hands on it! Our special research team will take care of all findings. Would you like to lend us a hand? The Empire will make it worth your while! We'll give you access to all our latest findings. Well, are you interested?
Are you willing to help? You will receive payment in Training Camp Explorer tokens, which you can spend on different things we find there or donate to increase your reputation. Help your Motherland, comrade, and the Motherland will help you.
What do you want to know?
Very well. How many tokens would you like to credit to your account?
Very well. How many tokens would you like to donate?
As you wish. Let's do so.
Greetings! Do you want to be a hero and become famous?
What do you want to know?
Very well. How many Training Camp Explorer tokens would you like to credit to your account?
Very well. How many tokens would you like to donate?

Participate in skirmishes in Training Camp and earn Training Camp Explorer tokens. Your gain will be bigger for a victory, and you will receive a bonus if you rank one of the first three positions in healing and damage ratings. You can credit them to your account or spend them on the goods I'm selling. What else would you like to know?
Hello! Would you like to become an explorer?
What else do you want to know?

To help us with our mission, you need to participate in skirmishes at the Tower of Order. For participation, victory, and first places in the damage or healing rankings, you will receive Sculptor Shards. Use them to add them to your account. Afterwards, you can purchase goods from me. Additionally, you can find special contracts at the Boutique - they will increase the number of Shards gained. What else would you like to know about our mission?

Did you feel something? Is someone watching you? That's right, Sculptor watches the fights. You were right to be suspicious. The ultimate goal is not a victory or conquer. The Sculptor seeks knowledge. It's still too early for you to know it all. Don't get upset, though. I can offer you Sculptor's gifts that will come in handy.

What do you call this ridiculous discipline that arranges and explains the chaotic behavior of living beings? Right, that would be sociological experiment. We watch you fight, and we can control the course of the battle. I can't tell you whether we're reaching a conclusion, but the process is amusing. I'm offering you the latest gifts of the Sculptor as a reward.

Oh well, it's time for you to learn the truth. Did you know that our Creator had conceived us as destructors? He wanted us to destroy the world that was his prison. Are we destined to put an end to Sarnaut? How bad is our inclination toward self-destruction? That's what the Sculptor tried to figure out. Oh, so you care about the result, don't you? The Sculptor said we were Chaotic beings, and we didn't have to follow the path we'd been programmed for. Everything we do is our choice. We either destroy the world or not. Well, it's kind of encouraging. Your help will be rewarded with the most interesting Sculptor's gifts.

We are Sculptor's disciples. Don't be alarmed, we're not as mad as the goblin. Our mission is simple. Do you want to know what it is? I'm keeping the cards face down just yet. Let's negotiate a business deal. Do you know the Tower of Order? Go there and fight. We're paying well.
If you agree, listen up. You'll earn Sculptor's shards, which you can spend on goods or donate for reputation. It's a tough call, but it's part of the deal. Perhaps, the most important deal in your life. Are you interested now?
Hi! Do you want to support our mission?

To help us with our mission, you need to participate in skirmishes at the Tower of Order. For participation, victory, and first places in the damage or healing rankings, you will receive Sculptor Shards. Use them to add them to your account. Afterwards, you can purchase goods from me. Additionally, you can find special contracts at the Boutique - they will increase the number of Shards gained. What else would you like to know about our mission?

Did you feel something? Is someone watching you? That's right, Sculptor watches the fights. Studies. Judges. The ultimate goal is not a victory or conquer. The Sculptor seeks knowledge. It's still too early for you to know it all. Don't get upset, though. I can offer you Sculptor's gifts that will come in handy. That would be all.

Information is valuable in itself. The ultimate goal is the experiment. You could also call it a sociological experiment. We watch you fight, and we can control the course of the battle. We change conditions, study your reactions, and make conclusions. I can't tell you anything just yet. In the meantime, I'm offering you the latest gifts of the Sculptor as a reward.

It's time for you to learn the truth. The Creator's mission is to put an end to the world. He conceived all living beings as destructors. He wanted us to destroy the world that was his prison. And that's exactly what we're destined to do, early or late. The question is, what are the odds of us putting an end to Sarnaut? How bad is our inclination toward self-destruction? That's what the Sculptor tried to figure out. The outcome: the Creator gave birth to chaotic creatures with free will. Conclusion: the world will be destroyed. Or not. It's half and half: we either destroy the world or not. On Creator's behalf, I express my gratitude for your kind assistance. It will be rewarded with the most interesting Sculptor's gifts. That would be all.

We are the Sculptor's Disciples. There is nothing to fear – we have no affiliation to the fanatics from Dane. We won't talk about our goals yet. We're offering a deal. Tower of Order. You know that place, right? Go there and fight. You will receive a special reward for your efforts.
Deal? Then this is what you need to know: you will be rewarded with Sculptor Shards. You can exchange them for goods or give them to me for free – that will increase your reputation. This is all part of the deal. Perhaps the importance of this deal in your life should be emphasized. That sounds interesting, doesn't it?
Whatever you say, I'll accept it.
Greetings. Are you willing to help?

Look at the bodies of these fools. Like you, they thought they could challenge me. Ha! Raise your heads, those who believe in the Light, and behold the true POWER! The keeper will not let me perish! What is the Light compared to this?!
Well, then I have a small chance of seeing an interesting fight! Prepare to die, sister!
Keeper! Look! I’ll crush them in your name! And if I die, take me with you...
What? Fight? Me? Can do... How many of you are there? Six? That’s not much... Not enough for a soup.
Challenge? Me? Ha... May the skies show you mercy.
Not smart, sister. Not smart at all.

You traveled such a long distance just for me? I'm flattered... But you've made quite a mess! So much blood - was it worth it? Why are you here? Came to eradicate evil? Pretending to be heroes? He he.. Well, we both know how our meeting will end. Let's not waste any more time.
Would you look at that. Caught a flying chicken and thinks she’s important now. Big mistake.
Doesn’t scare you? Well, let me reveal a deadly secret to you...
Looking for glory? I don’t think so. Like many before you, you want spoils! But my sisters could use a workout. You’ll be fighting them to death.
A woman... Among these creatures? Well, I have to inform you of the rules of the fight. You have the right to ask for the Keeper's patronage. Tell that to the champion you'd like to challenge.
So be it. There’s enough space for corpses in Astral.

Cursed sorcerers!  Look what they did to the soil!  My father, a mage scientist, said they were nothing but trouble, and he was right! Look around you! Women rule now! Wait, what? How did I go from soil to women? But it's all because of them! Cursed sorcerers!

But let me tell you... Just try my pumpkin, it's non-AMO. What's AMO? Astrally modified organism, you ignoramus! I don't let sorcerers mess with my goods, they are all fresh. All of them! Here, try this pumpkin...
Man, that "Servant of Tensess" fella is one tough cookie! Or is it just that I lost my form after years without a good fight? No worries, methinks I'll need to recall my glorious past soon enough!

Child of Chaos!

The Darkness never sleeps. You already know it’s coming. While the others are trying to save their hides, I’ll tell you how to fight.
 I came here bearing news for the strongest leaders of this world. I will help you create an indestructible stronghold where you can give battle to the forces of Darkness. To accomplish that, you must join forces, or else you are fated to be destroyed.

Guild Heraldry allows you to purchase Guild Accessories and use Guild Tactics that increase your allies' combat efficiency on Dominion.

All Guild members should put in some work to increase the Guild Heraldry rank.

Gather Marks of Deeds and reach a certain level of Prestige to gain a Heraldry rank.

t: Congratulations! The Heraldry rank has been increased.

Ah, you’re here. Great.

Recently I discovered a schematic for an old mechanism powered by Crystal Chips. It alchemically transforms chips into... Just about anything.

It’s not a secret that you have access to an inexhaustible source of Crystal Chips, and you know a thing or two about magic tech. So it was logical to contact you.

I’m willing to show you the schematic and see what you can learn.

Well, it looks functional. We need to determine whether its transmutation properties have a threshold... And unwanted side effects. Ancient mechanisms are infamous for that.

Keep me appraised.

Lately we discovered an interesting thing in the journals of our ancestors. They knew more about Crystal Chips than we could possibly imagine!

For example, you can employ an alchemical technique to transform chips into... just about anything! Of course, we immediately thought of the goods in the Boutique. All that for just a handful of chips!

There’s only one problem – we need to build a special mechanism. And magic tech is beyond us, so... Perhaps you can help us? We have the schematic – you just need to build it!

Oh, wow! Just like the schematic! Well, that makes sense...

Now we need to make this thingamabob work! I’m sure you can figure this out, too. I mean, what if it explodes...

Make sure to tell us everything when you’re done!
Meow, how can I be of service?

Meow story is simple, meow lordlady! I'm an ordinary cat who serves the Free Traders! I grew up on a distant allod where meow owner was a very rich and influential gentleman. But then he died, and now I'm forced to wander in search of a better life, selling meow blade to whoever pays best for it!
Greetings! I'm sorry, I can't stop and chat - I'm on duty...!
The Anniversary Lion lottery is held every day! The first twenty winners will receive this unique mount
Having fun? Seems that way. And can you believe that? No one is holding anyone by the throat or kicking their skulls in.
What's your score? The higher your score, the more prizes you get!

Oh, great. You're here, too.

Having fun? Seems that way. And can you believe that? No one is holding anyone by the throat or kicking their skulls in. If they all met ten years ago - you can imagine the scuffle, I'm sure.

What I mean is, the world has changed. And it happened thanks to you. Yes, yes, no need for modesty.

Rysina and Yasker are side-eyeing me, but I'm sure they've come to accept the fact that Orc Psionicists exist. My school is flourishing. We are gathering talents from all over Sarnaut. We even visit savages that probably skewered some unlucky travelers just yesterday - and we find gems there. And that is thanks to you, too.

! You're here, too!

We came here right after Irene. There's something we need to discuss...

With the Empire, too! No, I had nothing to do with any rebellions. That's Shamans' doing, I had no idea what they were planning...

Ugh, soon I'll have to start training... on Nea. It's too bad I'll have to leave my school... Though they promised to keep an eye on it. Who? Unn, that furball. She has some kind of authority with the Gibberlings, so everything should be all right on Coldberg.

I hope I'm not in trouble... Because Rysina and Yasker have been giving me dirty looks. Anyway, congratulations on your Anniversary!

Ha ha, ! The old friends are together once again.

I was miraculously released from this Suslanger! It was nothing but trouble. I was starting to forget my titles and regalia... Who am I? A trainer of Orc Psionicists? Zayan’s apprentice? The chief of the Horde? A navigator of other worlds?

Ugh, the thought makes me shudder. There's one good thing about it - Fury is helping me. She is a sensible one, even if hot tempered. If she sees a problem, she goes at it with an axe! Heh.

Anyway, we decided to take a break from all that... Let Kurgan lead them for now. We're going to travel around the world for a month or so, while there's still time...

Time until what? Didn't Eladia tell you? Hmm, maybe I shouldn't say anything, but they are mounting an Expedition. And they can't do it without me, since I'm... the navigator. But it takes time to prepare everything... And they still can't find that damn Chronophone. It would take even longer to build another one. So we still have time to kill.

Well, if they haven't called you yet, they will soon. Rest for now! Well, see you around.

Heh, it's nice to be back in Sarnaut! It's not fun in Eden: every tree thinks aloud, making your head hurt.

Well, if this is a party, let's celebrate. I've heard the news - who knew it would turn out like this? It means Klavdia miscalculated...

I'll be going to Suslanger with Fury: I need to see what the Landfill Warriors are up to, hehe... And then, perhaps, I'll return to Zayan - I still need to complete this training.

Yes, I knew you would do the same! But of course you would. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

And as for Felix and his iron blockheads - as defenders of Sarnaut they are worthless. Just fools who messed up when they put us at war with the Children.

Yes, it was unpleasant. But I couldn't do otherwise, and neither could Eurial. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

But I don't hold grudges, so if you're ready to forget about the past, then I'll forget it, too.
I found the best hiding spot!

Very interesting...

Children of Chaos attach a lot of importance to certain dates of the cycle. I noticed you need special rituals to remember your past.

Even now, when your sun is hidden from you, so you cannot measure time the way you could before.

What drives you? It's unclear.

Child of Chaos...

The time when you will have to make a choice is near.

I detect a temporal effect spreading throughout the world. Someone is trying to change the course of events. To warp the river of time into meanders. No, Cosmos has no part in it.

Soon you will understand everything. For now, celebrate.

Hello, hello!

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

I guess you would like to learn about your future. About Horizon and everything else I showed you.

Know that the future can be changed. It is like roads –– they fork and merge. Have you seen the Frozen Frontier? The way it looked before the end? Then, perhaps, you've seen Horizon as well. These are all versions of the future. If I make a step to the side, the road will change.

But is there a path where Sarnaut is saved? I touched all the Threads one by one, but alas, the path I showed you is the most likely one. And yet there's still hope. I believe everything is in your hands.

Greetings, !

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

I guess you would like to learn about your future. About Horizon and everything else I showed you.

Know that the future can be changed. It is like roads –– they fork and merge. Have you seen the Frozen Frontier? The way it looked before the end? Then, perhaps, you've seen Horizon as well. These are all versions of the future. If I make a step to the side, the road will change.

But is there a path where Sarnaut is saved? I touched all the Threads one by one, but alas, the path I showed you is the most likely one. And yet there's still hope. I believe everything is in your hands.

Greetings, !

I wonder what the Threads are saying? It's an interesting matter, because the predictions are starting to get confusing...

I thought our future was set in stone, and the Darkness would swallow Sarnaut, but since then, the visions have been showing me something different. And it looks like someone is trying to change the pattern, tangling the Threads. It's unprecedented, but I can't say it's completely unbelievable.

In our family, only some of the legends about the past are preserved, because we only had a few weaver's looms on our island. The True Holders of the Thread could read the Fabric of the World more accurately, but they all remained on Isa, our ancestral home, and it no longer exists.

Oh child, who knew it would turn out like this! The Darkness outwitted everyone, and we... couldn't do anything! They say Nihaz created a false future in order to deceive us all... It was very, very cunning, but no one has been able to escape fate yet. When he diverted the course of the river of time, the god of darkness might have sealed his fate.

The future will show us the truth. Right now I'm here to tell you that I'm going to New Isa, to the Great Tree. Disturbing news came from Froddy. Something troubling is going on. I need to see everything myself, and then I will tell you what it is.

You and I found Isa, child... Who knew Fortune would favor us so... But something bothers me... The Weaver abilities you gained... Last time that happened, it was a response to the arrival of the Scissors embodied by the Architect... Who is it this time? Skulnar the Northwind? I don't know...

It's nice to get some fresh air. Shh, I'm incognito here.

So many important people. I'm surprised they didn't invite the whole Conclave. But you know, people would rather go to a party than a war. How many of them will join our ranks when the time comes? Exactly.

Daddy will make his move soon. He enjoys toying with us for now, but when push comes to shove, he is ruthless.

But alright, I won't spoil your fun. Enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.

Oh, we can't do it without you, ! We've been waiting for you!

Alright, enough joking. You see, not everyone danced at the Balls and drank Irene wine this year. Some of us were actually busy!

It worked well with the army of dead. They did your job for you. Your assault on the Citadel could have gone a little better. Rewards are all you care about!

You didn't make it to the last level? I bet "Father" would be so pleased!

But this is not about him. Destroying another avatar? It's about time, but it won't solve all our problems. I have a solution. What kind? Ah, you're so quick with words. I wish you were as efficient with your actions. I'll tell you everything later... When the time comes.

For now, have fun - go fly a glider and win that lion if you haven't already.

So not a single event happens without you, ? Perhaps it's true.

Look at them. They will drown you in words, predictions, promises, maybe even veiled threats...

Do not trust anyone. Now is the moment you can determine your own future.

You need to understand that the choice is yours. And you will have to make it no matter what.

Sometimes it's good to take a break from work...

So who do we have to thank for this celebration? You, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. You started this chain of events 10 years ago.

Let us remember how much we've lost over the years. Those who gave their lives to bring this day closer. Does anyone remember the allods Arav, Ark, Jalin, Imbul, or Karakir?

If we don't preserve what we have left – our descendants will not forgive us!

I'm glad to see you here, ! Let no one say the Empire cares about nothing but wars. If there's a potential for peace, we do our best to realize it.

We have enough problems without having to fight the League. Together, we can accomplish so much more. That is why we initiated a cultural exchange program - this is our chance to show everyone a more progressive life. When they see the beauty of Xadaganian cities, they will understand that our path is the right one. That's the Great Nezeb's will.

Allow me to congratulate you on behalf of the Conclave of the Empire, even though my colleagues, Great Mages, are absent from this event.

So, on behalf of the Great Mage Simon from Suslanger, Great Mage Felix from Yakhch, Great Mage Leonid from New Igsh, Great Mage Abram from Vechnoslavsk, Great Mage Rustam from Istinsk, Great Mage Mansur from Manodar, Great Mage Negus Nevzr from Izune, and from all other Great Mages of small allods of the Empire - happy anniversary, !

I often wonder how the world has changed since your journey began, . Yes, a lot of things have already been discovered, and mana power engineering has been rapidly developing. Perhaps, thanks to you, we gained a variety of new goods.

The City Council is still counting the trophies we got after defeating Gorluxor; the technologies created by Tep for the world of illusions are still being studied at ZIT Headquarters.

And now we are ready to go to another world. Again, with the help of technologies we obtained thanks to you. The world is changing, and these changes are inevitable. Even the drowsy League is forced to move forward now. Its representatives such as Catherina are often more imperial in spirit than many of the conservative bureaucrats from Yasker’s Tower.

What will you find outside Sarnaut? I'm confident that, whatever it is, it will change our world once again.

Ah, it's you...

Are you expecting words of encouragement or something? There'll be none. We are all prisoners of Hirkalla who now rules Sarnaut from her throne in Jigran. She is called the Darkest Mistress, so go ask her for parting wishes...

Greetings, hero!

Well, I'm not disappointed this time... Yes, some things could have been avoided, and you should have been more careful and not trusted strangers with important state secrets... But what got we wanted: Hirkalla was weakened. As for Tep... He was beaten the first time, so he'll be beaten a second time. That's what I think.

This time by the forces of the Great Mages. They didn't gather here for nothing - the hunt for Tep is underway, and we're ready to strike. After all, over the past years we've learned a lot, discovered things that you have no idea about, so we might surprise the old necromancer yet!
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!

Many interesting events take place on the Eclipse!

You can go on a tour of the Holy Land. Another ship will take you there!

Guests can also participate in fist fights and a battle of sailplanes!

You can also converse with other guests, set off fireworks, or join a lottery where you can win an Anniversary Lion!
Two Great Mages are on the ship right now – Yasker and Aidenus! They entrusted their allods to their students so they could attend this celebration!
Demon Hunters are also here! They would like you to fight them in the ring.
Be on the boarding device at the scheduled time – a ship will take you to the Holy Land and back.
The boarding device is on the main deck.
The boarding device is on the main deck.
You can find the head of the Empire in his camp.
There are sailplanes on the lower deck – everyone can test-drive them.
The entrance is right behind me.
The entrance is right behind me.
You can find the head of the League in his camp.
If you need to get rid of anniversary coins quickly, visit the Coin Master!

Hello, hello!

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

It's nice to get some fresh air. Shh, I'm incognito here.

So many important people. I'm surprised they didn't invite the whole Conclave.

But you go on, enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.

Sometimes it's good to take a break from work...

So who do we have to thank for this celebration? You, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. You started this chain of events.

Constant rumpus, weird odors, lazy and arrogant citizens. That's what the capital is like!

I can see you're not one of them. Pleased to meet you. We are Demon Hunters, and we came here to take a break from our routine slaughter in the Astral. Everybody needs rest!

Aho.

It's not easy to defeat me – land at least fifteen hits.

Bet a gold coin on your victory. You might get lucky.
Hm... It looks like you don't have any gold.
Rejoice in victory, akyly. Take some rest now.

Fame and respect, of course! And a dozen of bruises, too.

For winning over Glum, you will be rewarded with a Copper Anniversary Coin; for winning over Lanky, with a Silver one; for winning over Fang, with a Gold one!
Can't you see, there's already someone in the ring!
...The Priden silently shakes his head and nods at the fighters in the ring.
Wait a bit, the ring is occupied.
Huh! Come again later, when you are well-rested.

I looked around at those next to me. Apprentices, future "mechanics", and a number of mechanical knights who are imperfect and clumsy. The transfer of Sparks has proved to be very promising. However, not every Spark will take root in a new body. I need to find a way to contact those Arisen and find out how they get around the issue of "rejection". But Nezeb jealously guards his "scientists". So far, only my first knight remains an ideal model without any flaw.

Sooner or later...

SCARGE WILL BE THE FORCE OF PROGRESS IN KANIA

...and perhaps in the entire Sarnaut.

Greetings!

Here you can buy hot tea, cold ale, strong grog, fresh oranges, rich soups, and delicious steaks.

Do you want to have a drink or a snack?
A bad day of fishing is better than a good day of work!
Are you raising a bird mount? You already have excellent fishing gear. Sit down, fishing is good here today!
My name is Chereh. I'm kinda in charge here. Watching out for hapless swimmers and jacklighters. But if you want to fish - just ask me for the gear!

There's an unusual fish in our Crystal Lake. It's the Ice Fish. It lives on the bottom where the water is so cold that you'd turn into an icicle if you dived deep enough. You can catch it only during New Year's celebrations. People set off fireworks and have fun - and the fish gets closer to the surface to watch the bright lights.

I'd be amazed if you catch it. I'll even give you a special bait, but it only lives about a day, and it's hard to find. Remember: if you lure the fish, it will increase your chances of catching it.
Here it is. It's icy cold, so don't freeze your hands off.
I'm sorry, that's all I have. Come back tomorrow!
Sorry, the birds are resting and can only give you a ride. Come back when it's time to hunt.
The bird is yours for free! Look after her and take care.
Keep it up! You're no coward, huh? Remember, if you fail this time, you can come back and try again in an hour! Just don't run anyone over...

You want to try and ride all the way from the top to the foot of this mountain? Well, I'm afraid it's not going to happen right now - the track is not ready yet. We'll tramp down the snow and reattach the ribbons - you know, the usual. Stop by later!

Hey! You want to have the best fun this icy rock has to offer? That can be arranged!

It's called Slalom, and it's the craziest race in the world! It seems simple - you just need to ride the board from the top to the foot. The one who finishes first, wins. However, the track is tricky - you'll have to avoid stones, trees, and other racers, and the speed is crazy! I'm telling you, not everyone is going to make it to the finish line.

Do you still want to participate?

Greetings! Welcome to the foothills of the highest mountain in the region! Only the bravest and reckless will dare to climb it in this weather. The wind is blowing hard, the Elementals are throwing icy boulders at you - lovely, isn't it?

Your mount will help you here – one of the creatures that are adapted to the local conditions: a Snowbug or a Snow Fury. Or even a Snow Owl, one of those that nest on highest slopes - if you can tame it, of course.

The first one to the top wins. The second gets a smaller reward, and the third one an even smaller one. Don't stop, or you'll freeze!
Don't know where you can sledge? No problem! Just one snowflake, and I'll take you to the top of the hill.

t:
Come on, join us in a snowball battle! Build your snow fortress and defend it from the enemies! If you last for several minutes, I'll give you a nice reward!

Just don't go anywhere outside the village. It's against the rules!
Hey there! We're playing snowballs here. You want to join us?

You'd rather attack than stick to defensive tactics, wouldn't you? Huh! Then go throw snowballs at someone sitting in a fortress, and win your reward!

Just don't go anywhere outside the village. It's against the rules!

So, are you going to make a snowman? Then you're going to need some branches for the arms, a carrot for the nose, and a lot of snow!

Come on, let's do it!

You need some branches, a carrot and snow. You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us.

You need to make three balls out of snow, then stick the branches where the arms should be and the carrot as a nose - and the snowman is ready!

Oh, those funny children! No, let them worship their crocodile. We are similar in many ways, although I never needed my own people. My followers are those who honor winter, who believe in the power of icy rivers and sparkling snow.

After all, winter is a dream everyone needs. A dream can be both good... and evil. But you know that. I'm sure you've had a chance to meet Cold. He is harsh. If he could, he would freeze the entire world.

And I'm the one who ensures that Winter comes and goes. This is the essence of the cycle of the year. We all come out one after another: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall. We do our best even though it's not easy, since the world is divided.
It's just a hobby. What's wrong with it?
What of it? You're such a bore.
You should try it, it's fun.
I do it for the community! Trees get cold, too...

Am I not allowed to rest?

I wonder how you know all that? Were you watching me...?
We have the best goods here!
Greetings, dear friend! Welcome to our village. We live simply and sure know how to have fun! I bet you'll love it here.

Oh hey!

I can teach anyone to ice skate! Do you want to try it? It's easy: just put on the skates, then push with your feet and use your arms to balance! Just watch out for the obstacles, and don’t skate on snow and thin ice, which is darker. See, it's not difficult at all!
Hey there! We're playing snowballs here. You want to join us?

Hey! My name is Brody, also known as Sculptor...

I must say, I'm not a real sculptor yet, but my snowmen are top-notch! There's nothing better than sledging. What? You don't have a sledge? Don't worry, I'll let you borrow mine. Go up there and try it yourself!

t: The sacred lanterns standing along the roads are not here just to give light, but also to drive away Frost Spirits, terrible spawns of winter which can turn anyone into a lifeless statue. They are only afraid of light, laughter, and high spirits, so this is why we decided to build here a resort for all the people of Sarnaut and devote it to Genlun!
I knew you were into fishing right away!

Hello! Hello! I'm new to this village, it's nice to meet you. I'm the best Roc trainer out there! My Rocs won't just give you rides - they will also be your faithful companions on a real winter hunt! Come to me every hour at the 20th or 40th minute and see for yourself.
Come here, friend! Captain Solonus will procure anything for you!

The main difference between a cross-faction auction and a regular one is that here both the League and the Empire can see the goods and buy them from each other. Other than that, it is the same auction - a place where everyone can try to sell their items or buy something unique that can't be found anywhere else.

It's very easy to use the auction. If you decide to sell something, you will need to talk to me and fill out a special form. First you need to select the item you wish to sell. Then specify the time period, the starting bid, and the buyout price. Not setting a buyout price may improve bids! Once you filled out all the required fields, confirm the request. I will put your item up for sale immediately. Not free of charge, of course. A small auction tax is imposed on all sale proceeds.

I can also help you find something useful at the auction. There's a different request form for that. You can search by quality, level, or name. If you decide to purchase something, you can buy the item immediately if it has a buyout price. Or simply place a bid that is higher than the current bid. But remember: other buyers can outbid you at any time.

All sales proceeds and all items purchased are mailed to you. Unsold items can also be retrieved from the mailman after the action ends.

Come on, join the fun known as the Auction. It's so exciting! Like a battlefield!

Chewacca and I got tired of sitting around in Skewer, especially when they caught Caligula. Slushy Slug controls everything now, the nasty worm.

"I have a bad feeling," I said, and we bailed. Got into a jam on the way and had to run from the imperials, but then we met Ilenia and Denis who offered us this new opportunity.

They smuggle goods through Howlem these days, but there's a way to do it legally.

So we picked this place - it suits us perfectly, and now we can arrange cross-faction trading. If you need to sell anything, talk to me.

Ilenia can exchange crystals for you, and if you need a bank, Denis Zharin will help you.
Please... Spare a coin? I could share something interesting with you... For example, a prediction or a World Mystery.
It’s hard to be poor... It’s easy being rich!
The Grey Prince is keeping an eye on us! A coin here, a coin there...
I’m afraid we’ve reached the processing limit for today. Come back tomorrow, child of Chaos!
Wonderful! How much would you like to turn in?

Every day you will be given special tasks that will help you create items for upgrading equipment.

These tasks will not require you to do anything you haven't already done. Just normal heroic activities - defeat these and save these... But don't worry: there are mundane tasks, too. Like converting Enchanted Shards and Matter using Tools, for example. Practice makes perfect!

Completing these tasks will earn you Enchanted Matter, Amalgam, and Gold.

Once a day, you can turn down a task to get another. If you turn down two tasks, you'll have to wait until the next day.

To stop receiving these daily tasks, talk to me.
Alright! If you want me to start giving these quests again, just tell me!

First of all, we are talking about the second rank equipment, also known as Precious Equipment. You can identify it by the number II on each item. Unlike the first rank that can be found anywhere, or the third one that is really hard to get, the second rank requires only patience and persistence, along with a handful of resources.

First of all, you will need boxes with loot. You can find them everywhere: on astral allods, in Skirmishes, in raid adventures. There's plenty! I'll give you one from my personal stash for teaching purposes.

These boxes contain fragments of equipment. They will require some work before you can turn them into something suitable. You'll need tools for that. The better your tools and fragments, the more material you will get, which means you can craft a full set of equipment sooner! There are different tools. You can buy common tools for gold. You can craft yourself better tools or get them from the Boutique or by participating in Skirmishes. Participants of the Guild Dominion can receive the best tools! You should try out different tools and see for yourself.

You will also need a suitable workpiece. It can be crafted by a member of a Profession or purchased from other players.

Once you have the workpiece and materials, all you need to do is craft the equipment! It's simple: the anvil will do everything for you. You just need a bit of gold.

To craft a Hero’s Insignia, you need Enchanted Dust and Amalgam. Enchanted Dust can be obtained by converting Enchanted Matter using tools. It can be obtained by helping in adventures on astral allods and by completing Distortions.

Amalgam can be acquired by converting Drops of Amalgam that are earned in Skirmishes, Tka-Rik's Cave, or obtained by completing special alchemical quests. Once you have all the components, use the Anvil of Artifacts. You will be able to create the insignia in the appropriate section. To upgrade a piece of equipment, use a Hero's Insignia on the item.

Universal Tools are of the same quality as crafted tools. But they are easier to get - the Boutique is always at hand, after all. And they are a pleasure to work with.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.

Here you go. These tools are much better than common crafted ones. Although they are not as easy to get. Tensess knows crafting them would take less time.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.

The material we get from the Astral is pretty good, but to use it most effectively, we need special workpieces. Professions can craft suitable workpieces. Blacksmiths craft armor, leatherworkers make leather, and tailors make cloth. Weaponsmiths craft weapons. There is a fifth type - jewelry workpieces. Any Profession can make those.

But what if you need a workpiece from a Profession you're not trained in? Or you don't want to waste time at some workshop?

There's a solution: ask other players, and they will happily sell you everything you need. There are plenty of lots at the auction, but remember that a seller always sells goods at an upcharge. So a Profession is not just an interesting, but also a profitable occupation.

Over the year, you will gradually unlock better quality workpieces. To learn new recipes, talk to the master of your Profession in the capital.

Each hero has their own costume: a warrior will not put on a robe, and a mage will not wear fur skins. But why not? It is the season of experimental fashion! Whatever your path is, you can wear anything. I sell costumes for Anniversary Coins which you can obtain by fighting monsters. When you reach level 10, you can buy costumes for beginners, at level 30 you can get costumes for more experienced heroes, and at the maximum level - costumes for the most influential ones. Those who achieved Greatness have access to the best costumes and accessories. I have clothes for any occasion - in any color and style!

Just another blind kitten, whose eyes are about to open. Boy, do I like what I'm beginning to see! Our old names will mean nothing soon, you'll see.
It was... wonderful! Forgetting everything and starting afresh! This time we can make it. Right?

Oh, Darkness? Darkness is good. It hides everything I don't want to see. Darkness is the new order of things. The undisturbed, quiet world, ready for the new dawn, for the change. Ready for new beginnings.

It's very near. And it's far away... Ah...

Why am I here? I'm just a harbinger. The Dark condescended to you. It's the greatest honor.

What am I heralding? Ugh, the ability to listen has never been your forte. The message has been delivered. Now it's just a matter of time.

I remember... I remember a dream, which is a rare thing.

The dream about the future. About what's going to happen later, on another Earth, under a different sky. The grandchildren of our grandchildren are going to live in the light of Darkness. Our names and our deeds will be gradually erased from history.

Ah, don't you worry, your help is valuable the way it is. You're on of the protagonist! The main character of the Show!

The monumental character, both tragic and comic, like the fate itself.

It's all right. The amazing new world will welcome everyone.

It's weird, though. All roads lead back to you, through all the wondrous places and mysterious times.
...The Sphere slowly pulsates and slightly raises above the ground, expressing its consent.
...The Sphere seems to be woven from bright flames. It hovers in the air and radiates the sense of calamity and ease.
You're right. We better get going.
If you say so. You first!
I got it. We will handle this quickly!
Wherever I go, my sword will cut my way through!
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
That's one hell of a place, right?
Some nasty critter can jump at you from the bushes at any moment, so we need to keep our eyes open...
Well. Why do you care about his pleas? Oh, right, I keep forgetting. Well, let's talk since you're here anyway.

Oh, wait, wait a minute. What challenge are you talking about? We're too adult for that kind of stuff. As custom has it, why don't we make a bet? A simple one. Without room for cheating. I'll be generous. You can have not only Ath-Zak's Spark, but also the Sparks of his girlfriend Luja-Gialla and the June Great Mage Tka-Rik. If you can complete the trials, of course.
